name: Epitaph 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Angular display capitals with rising crossbars, bowed M stems and sharply cut terminals.
observed: Directly sampled characters: 2345789ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPRSTUVWYZ. The source is printed page 172, PDF page 178. Larger sizes anchor the master and smaller impressions supply missing sorts.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: JQX016. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Lowercase input aliases capitals. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Epitaph; printed p. 172, one-based PDF page 178, Internet Archive leaf 178
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Reviewed transcriptions and exact native crops are retained in source/rows.json, selections.json and tracing.json. Explicit new companions are retained separately.
